study type: Retrospective secondary analysis of a prospective longitudinal study
exposure: Gestational weight gain (total and categorized by Institute of Medicine recommendations)
finding: Maternal postpartum weight retention was significantly less in women who were normal weight or overweight at the onset of pregnancy and had gestational weight gain within Institute of Medicine recommendations; however, no statistically significant differences were seen in offspring weight-for-length percentiles based on maternal prepregnancy BMI or weight gain within guidelines.
